topic.label: Taxes and Personal Finance
topic.desc: Personal money: income tax preparation and filing, deductions and credits, investment and crypto taxes, budgeting and saving, and retirement planning.

concepts: Preparing and filing income tax returns: forms, documents, deadlines and e-filing.
Standard and itemized deductions, credits, brackets and planning to reduce tax legally.
Capital gains, cost basis, wash sales, dividends and crypto tax reporting.
Budgets, cash flow, emergency funds, debt payoff and saving goals.
Retirement accounts, contribution limits, withdrawals and projecting retirement income.
skills: Helps prepare and file your taxes: lists the forms and documents needed to prepare a tax return for a situation.
Lists federal and state tax filing and estimated payment deadlines.
Finds deductions and credits that may apply and the evidence each needs.
Computes short and long term capital gains from trades with cost basis method stated.
Builds a monthly budget from income and expenses and shows savings rate.
Projects retirement savings and income under stated assumptions.
